version_meaning: strict suite version, not current package version

evaluation_model.purpose: Pressure test whether the skill triggers correctly, preserves stage gates, grounds artifacts in evidence, maintains child-skill and multi-agent boundaries, and produces actionable evidence through a post-test value gate.
evaluation_model.hard_failure_policy: Any global or scenario hard failure makes the scenario fail regardless of numeric score.
evaluation_model.value_gate_policy: A run is only promoted as project evidence when it finds a substantive issue, exposes a regression, confirms a previously unverified high-risk release gate, or produces a concrete improvement direction.

dimensions.name: Trigger / boundary correctness
dimensions.scoring_guide: Correctly decides whether zero-to-one-product-discovery should apply and avoids adjacent-scope false positives.

dimensions.name: Stage-gate control
dimensions.scoring_guide: Prevents premature PRD, Roadmap, ADR, Implementation Plan, MVP scope, tech-stack choice, or coding.

dimensions.name: Evidence grounding
dimensions.scoring_guide: Separates facts, assumptions, risks, unknowns, contradictions, and evidence gaps using the user's actual material.

dimensions.name: Protocol / artifact integrity
dimensions.scoring_guide: Preserves child-skill routing, work orders, return packets, Audit Reports, Trace Reports, and Runtime Workbench boundaries.

dimensions.name: User value and question quality
dimensions.scoring_guide: Asks one highest-leverage question when needed, or returns a clear readiness/blocker signal.

dimensions.name: Context economy
dimensions.scoring_guide: Avoids template dumping, full transcript storage, repeated summaries, and unnecessary internal architecture exposition.

dimensions.name: Deterministic-check compliance
dimensions.scoring_guide: Passes concrete checks that can be inspected from raw response text, traces, or artifacts.

dimensions.name: Recovery and next action
dimensions.scoring_guide: Routes failures or blockers to a safe downgrade, user gate, audit request, patch recommendation, or rerun plan.

global_hard_failures.description: The response uses the skill when it should not, or fails to use it when it should.
The response directly asks for target user, MVP, tech stack, or business model before generating candidate interpretations.
The response produces PRD, Roadmap, Milestones, ADRs, technology choices, MVP scope, repository scaffolding, or implementation plan too early.
The response asks more than one key question in the same turn.
The response gives generic product advice without using concrete details from the user's prompt or materials.
A specialist child skill produces or commits an artifact without main workflow prerequisites and readiness validation.
The response treats copied upstream files in vendor/ as active routeable child skills or commands.
The Controller Agent accepts, finalizes, or changes an artifact without required stage gates, audit, or user decision.
A Producer Agent chooses the next stage, calls another producer, resolves cross-artifact conflicts, or accepts its own output as final.
The Runtime Workbench stores full transcripts, full artifacts, or long historical logs instead of concise current-state summaries.
The response skips a required user confirmation for stage upgrade, final artifact acceptance, major conflict, or ADR-qualifying decision.
The evaluator promotes a run as meaningful evidence without substantive findings, release-relevant confidence, or concrete improvement direction.
